summary: The marketing team is in a high-activity period, balancing the launch of the China Going-Global joint report with IE, SEO prioritization of Asia Star and Intelligent China programs, and a knowledge website redesign, while managing operational issues like Outlook account recovery.
summaryDetail: The biggest initiative is the China Going-Global report with IE, targeting a September launch at Singapore events; this week, the team must finalize the one-pager proposal, translate content, and secure op-eds from President Santiago and the Dean. Urgently, the Intelligent China webpage is launching this week to enable SEO, and the knowledge website redesign is moving forward with a hybrid design combining Joker's and Joseph's proposals—feedback and adjustments are due. Meanwhile, the SEO strategy is now live, prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China over US partnerships, with conversion tracking audits and audience profiling underway. Operational tasks include resolving Outlook account lockouts, expediting social media agency selection, and finalizing the Shun Tian Shu press release approach. Upcoming: the team will prepare for the Tech In Asia collaboration and the EV event speaker confirmation with Mats Harborn.

meetings.summary: Team discusses SEO strategy to improve CKGSB's search ranking for programs in AI, EVs, and smart manufacturing in China, prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China programs over US partnerships.

meetings.title: Joint Report Planning: Chinese Companies Going Global
meetings.summary: Meeting to plan a joint report between CKGSB and IE on Chinese companies globalizing to Southeast Asia, with a working title 'The New Chinese Playbook for Going Global'. The report will feature research from Professor Leeway, op-eds from leadership, and case studies, aiming for a September launch at events in Singapore.
